_comment: Anima Base v1 example. Replace LoRA filenames, triggerPrompt and basePrompt with the exact values used by your LoRA.
_turbo_note: Optional Anima Turbo/speed LoRA applied to every render. Leave empty for normal base generation.
_global_lora_note: Optional model-only Anima LoRAs applied to every character. Usually leave this empty and use characterProfiles.
_profile_note: One server handles all characters. Wayward talentName selects the matching profile. triggerPrompt is the LoRA activation token; basePrompt is the character identity description that must stay stable across scenes.

elena.gamePromptPrefixToStrip: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, original game identity tags

_complex_scene_note: Generic prompt-driven policy for difficult multi-person/contact poses. It does not depend on individual scene names. characterLoraScale applies only to the selected character profile LoRA(s), not global/style LoRAs.

complexScenePolicy.positivePrompt: two distinct people, clear body separation, coherent anatomy, correct limb count, clear interaction
complexScenePolicy.negativePrompt: merged bodies, fused bodies, conjoined bodies, duplicate body, duplicate person, extra torso, extra arms, extra legs, disconnected limbs, malformed limbs

_scene_hint_note: Optional exceptions only. Leave these empty unless one specific scene still needs special handling.
_prompt_note: Final positive prompt = global prefix + triggerPrompt + basePrompt + character prefix + automatic complex-scene hint + optional scene exception + Wayward scene prompt + character suffix + global suffix.
negativePromptPrefix: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, watermark, signature
